verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's .coderabbit.yaml lets users set rules that fire automatically on PR events. Auto-review can be gated by keywords, labels, branches, draft status and commit counts. The request-changes workflow automatically requests changes or approves based on review outcomes. CI/CD failures automatically trigger inline fix suggestions, and path/AST-grep rules automatically apply targeted review instructions. However, the triggers and actions are a fixed, review-centric set rather than a general event→action rule engine, and custom recipes appear to be one-click rather than event-triggered. Missing for 10: user-definable arbitrary event triggers and custom actions (e.g. webhooks or workflow rules), event-triggered custom recipes, independent/hands-on corroboration of the automation config.
